long_biography.plain_text:
The Rakuljić family moved from transporting construction sand to coastal tourism while Ivan was growing up in Krilo Jesenice. He learned the trade at sea with his father Jure. The family-built passenger business supplied the platform from which Ivan later founded Ivan Cruising as a separate private company.

Rakuljić remains both owner-director and working captain. His operating model joins navigation with charter planning, crew service and decisions about construction and refitting. When international demand collapsed, he designed a domestic island-cruise programme instead of leaving the company idle. The company remains privately held, with Rakuljić its sole member and authorised manager.
